description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection, which provides methods for performing server-side XML-RPC introspection, such as retrieving method signatures and listing available methods. It interacts with a remote server via a proxy object and handles fallbacks if certain features are unsupported.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Client_ServerIntrospection
classes.description: A class that encapsulates XML-RPC server introspection functionalities, including retrieving method signatures and listing server methods by using multicall or sequential calls.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs the ServerIntrospection object with a given XML-RPC client proxy.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethod
methods.description: Retrieves signatures for all server methods, attempting multicall first, then falling back to looping if multicall is unsupported.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByMulticall
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve all method signatures in one request via the system.multicall XML-RPC method.

methods.name: getSignatureForEachMethodByLooping
methods.description: Retrieves method signatures by calling system.methodSignature for each method individually.

methods.name: getMethodSignature
methods.description: Retrieves the signature for a specific method by calling system.methodSignature on the server.

methods.name: listMethods
methods.description: Lists all available methods on the server by calling system.listMethods.
